metadata.description: Turns version-ordered release notes (feat(vX.Y) blocks with Features / Fixes / Chores and dependency bumps) into a manager-facing Chinese monthly report: regrouped by capability domain, version spans on section titles, fixes collapsed, dependencies stripped of version numbers, fixed skeleton for month-over-month comparability.

plugins.name: monthly-report
plugins.description: Use when the user needs to roll a month of release notes up into a work report.
